doc.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022

title: Cookers regroup in 2020: upstate rehearsals and Van Gelder session
summary: After the March 2020 tour ended, the Cookers got tested, rehearsed upstate and recorded at Rudy Van Gelder's studio in a relaxed, safe setting.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: When you finally got back together with any of your ensembles, did you notice a positive difference with most of your fellow musicians because of what you’re describing?

I don’t have the full gamut yet because I haven’t, I really haven’t gotten together with anybody but the Cookers. One thing Covid has done is the casual get together I guess, I mean why have a jam session if you’ve got to put people at risk? So I mean I’ve always been a bit of a hermit so I’ve stayed in. I haven’t done anything with any other bands but the Cookers so I could only relate to them. And that was an interesting phenomenon. You’re talking about guys that have gone like at a breakneck pace for fifty years, that suddenly had to stop. They’d be like okay what am I doing? And when we got back together we were a little sloppy but nobody lost anything. I mean you know you wouldn’t think — I think the first time we got together — when did this all really start — so we were on tour in March of 2020. I mean February of 2020. And we finished like March 1st. And then less than two weeks later we were about to do a long European tour, like two or three weeks or maybe not that long. A couple of guys already had gigs over there and had gone to Europe, and then it was a big thing when things shut down to get them back home from Europe. We all stayed in touch, you know, and had those conversations like well what are you doing, but by that summer, by July, you know, that first crazy wave in New York was dying down, things were opening up a little bit, it was possible to do things. And I don’t know if it was something I sensed or maybe something in me, but it seemed like we needed to get together. Everybody just needed to do something, get back on track and play some music. On that tour in March of 2020 we were going to do a live album. We were preparing to do a live album, and probably record it in London. So we had a label that wanted to do a record and I just said look I’m going to try to do this when we control the situation, you know. We went to Rudy Van Gelder’s (a) because it’s a great studio and (b) it’s a stand-alone property. People can just drive up to the door and go in, and so we talked to everybody and everybody was way into it, and so okay we’ve all got to get tested. I guess the NBA bubble inspired me you know? Everybody got tested and they threw them all together and they were able to do

their thing for months. I just needed a few days. So we went upstate to a club I knew up there that was pretty large and comfortable and not open, and they let us use the place. We went up there for a couple of days and rehearsed. And then like everywhere, all I was trying to do was like out of the city, where people could just drive up to the place, not be on a subway, not be in a building or an elevator, nothing that would put anybody in potential harm’s way. So we got upstate. And we rehearsed a little bit, and it was hard to tell the difference, because it was so relaxed. I mean nobody had anywhere to go you know, we had all the time in the world, nobody was bothering anybody, nobody had a teaching obligation, nobody had another gig. So I mean I wish it could have been longer but it was just a couple of days up there. And then I think we had planned to do one gig, because one place was opening up, but in the end we didn’t do it. So we just rehearsed a little more and we went into Van Gelder’s. And it was the same thing. No rush, nobody had to be anywhere, big studio, we were, like I said, we were all tested. So it was nice to have that time and that balanced the fact that okay maybe we were, all the passion was there, all the things that make those guys great was there. But maybe we were a little sloppier here and there. But we had time to like, okay, let’s do it again you know. Sorry, go ahead.
